benchmark_suite: SPECTRA Phase 4 Validated Benchmark (64-Track Real-World Provenance Manifest + 36-Track Synthetic Verification)
scientific_validity_notice: 1. The 36-track synthetic cohort measures mathematical pipeline correctness, calibration/test split isolation, and DSP perturbation sensitivity on controlled acoustic vs. comb-artifact signals. 2. Real-world detection reliability is evaluated on the 64-track Real-World Provenance Manifest (54 Phase 3 binary-labeled AI/Human tracks across Group-Isolated Calibration/Validation/Test splits, 6 hybrid/DAW-remixed forensic tracks, and 4 untouched Future Evaluation Cohort recordings). 3. Independent detector scores are recommended over a fixed linear ensemble because linear blending degrades F1/AUROC when one detector experiences generator-version domain shift.

protocol.split_isolation: Group-isolated stratification by correlation_group_id (zero shared song projects, stems, creator accounts, or artists across calibration, validation, and test splits) + untouched future cohort.
protocol.threshold_selection_rule: Validation split selection of aggregation policy; calibration split threshold at FPR <= 0.05

real_world_music_evaluation.scientific_interpretation: 1. Why SONICS Gamma 5s previously produced low scores: (a) Evaluating a single 5s center window often landed on sparse instrumental intros or breakdowns (e.g. Ashes For Mercy P=0.0999 at center vs P=0.9060 top-3 window mean); (b) Stacking windows into a 3D tensor (B, F, T) triggered a torchaudio.functional.amplitude_to_DB batch bug where top_db=80 was computed across the global batch max rather than per window; (c) Upstream SONICS uses unit-std normalization rather than peak normalization. 2. Multi-Window & Long-Context Improvements: Upgrading SONICS Gamma 5s to independent unit-std windows with top-3 active window aggregation improves Udio recall from 14.3% (1/7) to 71.4% (5/7) and Suno v4 recall from 66.7% (2/3) to 100% (3/3). Enabling SONICS SpecTTTra-alpha (120s) with reflection padding and a 45s minimum context gate raises Suno v3.5 recall from 55.6% (5/9) to 88.9% (8/9) and Suno v4 recall to 100% (3/3, mean P=0.964) with 0.0% FPR across all 22 verified human recordings (including pre-2002 GTZAN electric guitar rock and metal). 3. Generator Architecture Boundaries: Neither Fakeprint ONNX nor SONICS reliably detects continuous latent diffusion VAEs (Stable Audio 0/4, ACE-Step 1.0/1.5 1/6) because those generators do not use Suno/Udio's 200/400 Hz transposed-convolution stride or autoregressive vocal token patterns.

2. Creator Account Correlation: 5 Suno v3.5 tracks by account 'zayenkaelix' were distributed across calibration, validation, and test.
3. Artist Correlation: 2 human tracks by Kevin MacLeod were split between calibration and validation.
4. Genre Folder Correlation: Consecutive GTZAN rock (00001..00003) and metal (00001..00003) excerpts were distributed across calibration, validation, and test.

5. Terminology Correction: Because the 60-track cohort was inspected during Phase 3 failure diagnosis, its test partition is relabeled 'Historical Evaluation Split', and a separate 'Untouched Future Evaluation Cohort' has been added.

short_tracks_under_115s_padding_distorti.scientific_conclusion: On recordings shorter than 115s (n=28: 9 AI, 19 Human), upstream constant zero-padding fills 50%–75% of the 120s window with zeros, causing SONICS SpecTTTra-α to predict AI on 15/19 human tracks (78.9% FPR!). While Phase 3's reflection padding reduced human FPR to 2/19 (10.5%), reflection padding is NOT upstream preprocessing and fabricates palindrome audio reversals. Therefore, SpecTTTra-α (120s) MUST abstain on recordings < 115s and report the unmodified upstream zero-padded score solely for diagnostic transparency.

documented_edge_cases.explanation: Zero energy in 1-8 kHz yields an all-zero fakeprint residual vector. Because the upstream ONNX logistic regression model has a positive bias (+4.9827), raw ONNX output is 0.9932. SPECTRA reports the raw probability unmodified while triggering OOD Abstention (predicted_label='Abstained (OOD: Silence / Non-Broadband Signal)').

documented_edge_cases.case: Pure 440 Hz Sine Wave (Zero Energy in 1-8 kHz)
documented_edge_cases.explanation: A pure 440 Hz tone has no overtones inside the 1,000-8,000 Hz analysis window. SPECTRA detects band_1k_8k_energy_ratio < 0.005 and abstains with an explicit OOD warning.

documented_edge_cases.case: Pure 2000 Hz Sine Wave (Sparse Single-Bin Narrowband Tone in 1-8 kHz)
documented_edge_cases.explanation: Excites only a single narrow peak (<0.5% of the 3,585 bins in 1-8 kHz), failing to activate the negative broadband weights of the ONNX linear model. SPECTRA detects active_bin_ratio < 0.025 and abstains with an explicit OOD warning.

documented_edge_cases.case: Short 5s Clip Evaluated on Long-Context SONICS SpecTTTra-α (120s)
documented_edge_cases.explanation: Clips shorter than 115s lack the 120-second musical structure expected by SpecTTTra-alpha. SPECTRA uses exact upstream constant zero-padding and triggers transparent context-length abstention while preserving the raw score.
Detectors explicitly reject non-finite buffers with status='error' and probability=None.
